events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: Commemorating the day influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since the tragic passing of Tupac Shakur. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Marking the 56th anniversary of the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi's Genius
angles.copy: Today we remember Jimi Hendrix, a true guitar icon. His music continues to inspire generations. What's the Hendrix track that stops you in your tracks?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From the zebra crossing to those incredible tracks, it's an album that defined an era.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The voice of The Pretenders, still rocking. What's your top Pretenders tune?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! The iconic voice of Oasis and a true rock 'n' roll star. What's your favourite Liam moment or track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon urged us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple announced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, 25 years ago today.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago, Apple dropped this game-changer, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'. Did you have one?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the first 007 film premiere, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Your Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! The name's Bond, James Bond. Who's your favourite 007 and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring spirit and timeless music of John Lennon. His legacy lives on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What are your standout tracks from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking the 35th anniversary of the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Timeless Talent
angles.copy: 35 years ago, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to shine. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. A pivotal album that influenced so many. What's your top track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: A day to remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this date in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: 46 years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's his most impactful song for you?
